title: FST-* items
summary: Fastener item family covering bolts, screws, and washers across Manchester and Leeds stores, including stock balances, procurement, and production consumption.
body:
The `FST-*` item family encompasses assembly hardware, including metric bolts, screws, and washers in zinc-plated, stainless steel, and black finishes across Northbridge Cycles' facilities. These hardware components are stocked at Manchester Stores (WH-MAN-STR) and Leeds Stores (WH-LDS-STR) to support manufacturing lines and scheduled maintenance. As of 26 October 2026, stock balances and active purchase orders reflect high-volume consumption across active production work orders [^r1][^r2][^r33][^r40].

## Stock on hand

Stock levels across Manchester Stores (WH-MAN-STR) and Leeds Stores (WH-LDS-STR) as of 26 October 2026 09:00 include the following balances:

* **M3 Hardware**:
  * `FST-BLT-M3X6-BK`: 53,698 units on hand, 4,384 allocated, and 0 on order at WH-MAN-STR [^r3].
  * `FST-BLT-M3X6-SS`: 19,527 units on hand, 2,001 allocated, and 12,000 on order at WH-MAN-STR; 5,161 units on hand with 0 allocated at WH-LDS-STR [^r2].
  * `FST-BLT-M3X6-ZN`: 37,455 units on hand, 576 allocated, and 0 on order at WH-MAN-STR [^r1].
  * `FST-BLT-M3X8-BK`: 7 units on hand, 1 allocated, and 0 on order at WH-MAN-STR [^r5].
  * `FST-BLT-M3X8-ZN`: 15,644 units on hand (1,091 allocated) at WH-MAN-STR, and 3,633 units on hand (0 allocated) at WH-LDS-STR [^r4].
  * `FST-BLT-M3X10-SS`: 2,146 units on hand, 249 allocated, and 1,000 on order at WH-MAN-STR [^r6].
  * `FST-BLT-M3X12-SS`: 11,018 units on hand, 23 allocated, and 4,000 on order at WH-MAN-STR [^r7].
  * `FST-BLT-M3X35-BK`: 27,943 units on hand, 1,211 allocated, and 12,000 on order at WH-MAN-STR [^r8].

* **M4 Hardware**:
  * `FST-BLT-M4X6-BK`: 3 units on hand (1 allocated, 10 on order) at WH-MAN-STR, and 1 unit on hand (0 allocated, 0 on order) at WH-LDS-STR [^r9].
  * `FST-BLT-M4X10-ZN`: 30 units on hand (0 allocated, 10 on order) at WH-MAN-STR, and 1 unit on hand (0 allocated, 0 on order) at WH-LDS-STR [^r10].
  * `FST-BLT-M4X12-BK`: 76,284 units on hand, 2,522 allocated, and 30,000 on order at WH-MAN-STR [^r11].
  * `FST-BLT-M4X16-SS`: 23,358 units on hand, 5,735 allocated, and 30,000 on order at WH-MAN-STR [^r12].
  * `FST-BLT-M4X20-ZN`: 41,410 units on hand, 152 allocated, and 12,000 on order at WH-MAN-STR [^r13].
  * `FST-BLT-M4X30-SS`: 1,685 units on hand, 996 allocated, and 4,000 on order at WH-MAN-STR [^r14].
  * `FST-BLT-M4X40-BK`: 847 units on hand, 12 allocated, and 4,000 on order at WH-MAN-STR; 608 units on hand with 0 allocated and 0 on order at WH-LDS-STR [^r16].
  * `FST-BLT-M4X40-ZN`: 110,312 units on hand, 617 allocated, and 0 on order at WH-MAN-STR [^r15].

* **M5 Hardware**:
  * `FST-BLT-M5X6-ZN`: 109,633 units on hand, 6,628 allocated, and 0 on order at WH-MAN-STR [^r17].
  * `FST-BLT-M5X16-BK`: 74,283 units on hand, 6,093 allocated, and 0 on order at WH-MAN-STR [^r18].
  * `FST-BLT-M5X30-ZN`: 90,067 units on hand, 4,155 allocated, and 30,000 on order at WH-MAN-STR [^r19].

* **M6 Hardware**:
  * `FST-BLT-M6X6-BK`: 7,612 units on hand, 6,389 allocated, and 30,000 on order at WH-MAN-STR [^r20].
  * `FST-BLT-M6X8-SS`: 34,384 units on hand, 2,406 allocated, and 12,000 on order at WH-MAN-STR [^r21].
  * `FST-BLT-M6X8-ZN`: 15,884 units on hand, 0 allocated, and 0 on order at WH-LDS-STR [^r22].
  * `FST-BLT-M6X30-SS`: 104,969 units on hand and 30,000 on order at WH-MAN-STR; 29,199 units on hand at WH-LDS-STR [^r24].
  * `FST-BLT-M6X30-ZN`: 119,342 units on hand and 4,370 allocated at WH-MAN-STR, with 0 on order [^r23].

* **M8 Hardware**:
  * `FST-BLT-M8X10-BK`: 7,429 units on hand and 5,484 allocated with 30,000 on order at WH-MAN-STR, and 27,920 on hand at WH-LDS-STR [^r27].
  * `FST-BLT-M8X20-ZN`: 71,112 units on hand, 5,616 allocated, and 30,000 on order at WH-MAN-STR [^r25].
  * `FST-BLT-M8X30-ZN`: 66,125 units on hand, 3,818 allocated, and 30,000 on order at WH-MAN-STR [^r26].

* **M10 Hardware**:
  * `FST-BLT-M10X8-ZN`: 13,551 units on hand, 526 allocated, and 4,000 on order at WH-MAN-STR [^r28].
  * `FST-BLT-M10X10-SS`: 52,145 units on hand, 2,105 allocated, and 30,000 on order at WH-MAN-STR, alongside 11,122 units on hand at WH-LDS-STR [^r29].
  * `FST-BLT-M10X30-SS`: 67,860 units on hand, 7,374 allocated, and 0 on order at WH-MAN-STR [^r30].

For comprehensive inventory tracking, refer to [[data-stock-on-hand|Stock_on_hand_2026-10-26_0900]].

## Procurement and orders

Purchase order activity for `FST-*` hardware across 2026 includes:
* **2026-01-30**: 2,000 NOS of `FST-BLT-M3X25-ZN` ordered under PO/2026/00124 at £0.19 each from TF-DER-0877 [^r31].
* **2026-01-30**: 12,000 NOS of `FST-BLT-M10X12-ZN` ordered under PO/2026/00127 at £0.33 each from BBN-ODE-0467 [^r32].
* **February 2026**: Bulk orders up to 135,000 units per purchase order were placed, including `FST-BLT-M4X12-BK` (PO/2026/00189), `FST-SCR-M10X20-ZN` (PO/2026/00237), and `FST-BLT-M10X30-SS` (PO/2026/00247) [^r33].
* **2026-08-28**: 45,000 units of `FST-SCR-M5X20-ZN` ordered under PO/2026/01092 at £0.21 each from DF-NEW-0409 [^r34].
* **2026-08-31**: 6,000 units of `FST-BLT-M6X8-BK` ordered under PO/2026/01093 at £0.06 each from HF-GLA-0244 [^r35].
* **2026-08-31**: 1,500 units of `FST-BLT-M4X25-ZN` ordered under PO/2026/01095 at £0.14 each from KF-LEE-0301 [^r36].
* **2026-08-31**: 2,000 units of washer `FST-WSH-M6-BK` ordered under PO/2026/01096 at £0.47 each from PF-POR-0793 for WH-LDS-STR [^r37].

## Production consumption (Q3 2026)

Fasteners are drawn continuously against manufacturing work orders at WH-MAN-STR:
* `FST-BLT-M10X10-BK`: Opened Q3 on 1 July 2026 at 61,953 units [^r38]. Replenished with 6,000 units on 13 July (GRN/2026/29598), 24 July (GRN/2026/29665), and 29 July (GRN/2026/29697) [^r39]. Work order issues reduced stock from 52,626 on 12 August to 22,240 by 30 September 2026 [^r40].
* `FST-BLT-M10X10-SS`: Opened at 194,067 units on 1 July 2026, with early issues including 1,783 units for WO/2026/03182 and 2,398 units for WO/2026/06413 [^r41]. Stock declined from 175,167 on 15 July to 81,802 on 11 September [^r42], closing at 52,145 on 30 September 2026 [^r43].
* `FST-BLT-M10X10-ZN`: Opened at 4,959 units on 1 July 2026 and was issued in batches of 30 to 79 units through July and August [^r44], dropping from 2,744 on 19 August to 622 units on 30 September 2026 [^r45].
* `FST-BLT-M10X12-BK`: Opened at 7,080 units on 1 July 2026, received 1,000 units via GRN/2026/29533 on 2 July, and dropped to 7,123 by 20 July [^r46]. Continued issues brought stock to 3,927 on 17 September [^r47] and 3,201 on 30 September 2026 after issuing 32 units to WO/2026/07987 [^r48].
* `FST-BLT-M10X12-SS`: Opened at 8,694 units on 1 July 2026, reaching 6,242 units by 20 August (including 78 units for WO/2026/03111) [^r49], and closed at 3,824 units on 30 September 2026 after issues such as WO/2026/03266 [^r50].
* `FST-BLT-M10X12-ZN`: Opened at 31,876 units on 1 July 2026, reaching 27,967 units on 17 July [^r51] and 27,690 units on 20 July (following an issue of 277 units for WO/2026/05369) [^r52]. Work order issues including WO/2026/04337 (-257 units) lowered stock to 15,246 on 22 September [^r53], closing at 13,886 on 30 September 2026 after 152 units went to WO/2026/04672 [^r54].
* `FST-BLT-M10X16-BK`: Opened at 24,734 units on 1 July 2026, dropping to 12,944 units by 20 August [^r55]. Issues on 21 August (WO/2026/07467, -177 units) and 24 August (WO/2026/03065, -317 units) further reduced stock [^r56].
* `FST-BLT-M10X16-SS`: Opened at 192,953 units on 1 July 2026 [^r57]. Steady withdrawals reduced stock from 151,667 on 28 July to 54,262 on 25 September [^r58], ending at 46,998 units on 30 September 2026 [^r59].
* `FST-BLT-M10X16-ZN`: Opened at 6,502 units on 1 July 2026, dropping to 3,617 units by 25 August [^r60], and closing at 2,013 units on 30 September 2026 following issues for WO/2026/07861 and WO/2026/07660 [^r61].
* `FST-BLT-M10X20-BK`: Opened at 5,703 units on 1 July 2026, reaching 4,249 on 27 July [^r62], declining to 1,025 on 21 September [^r63], and ending at 549 units on 30 September 2026 following an issue for WO/2026/03968 [^r65].
* `FST-BLT-M10X20-SS`: Opened at 33,309 units on 1 July 2026 [^r64], closing September 2026 at 13,239 units following work order issues such as WO/2026/04303 and WO/2026/05440 [^r66].
* `FST-BLT-M10X20-ZN`: Opened at 82,572 units on 1 July 2026 [^r67].
